visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a white plate holding spaghetti with clams and crab meat, garnished with cherry tomatoes and green zucchini. A pair of hands enters the frame, using two forks to swirl and lift the noodles. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with other dishes visible in the soft-focus background on a wooden table. (2) Hands lift a slice of pizza from a wooden serving board; the pizza is topped with green angled loofah slices and melted cheese. The crust appears thin and crispy. The background remains consistent with the warm indoor lighting of a dining area. (3) A white plate featuring sliced beef steak, pink in the center, garnished with mini carrots, broccoli, and a green sauce. A hand uses a fork to pick up a piece of meat topped with green herbs. The lighting is focused and cinematic, highlighting the texture of the food. (4) A spoon scoops a portion of creamy risotto with grilled chicken chunks, cherry tomatoes, and microgreens from a shallow white bowl. The background shows the previously mentioned pizza. (5) A red ceramic pot is opened by a hand to reveal sautéed mushrooms and greens inside. Slices of toasted, golden-brown bread are arranged on the plate around the pot. (6) A hand holds a small crispy appetizer shell filled with a whole shrimp, white sauce, and edible flowers. (7) Wide panning shots of the restaurant interior show empty wooden tables with white napkins, wine glasses, and decorative flower arrangements. A person is sitting alone at a far table near a window. The walls are decorated with abstract blue paintings. (8) Exterior shot of the restaurant storefront under natural daylight. It features a black awning with 'PASADENA' text, glass doors, and promotional posters. The building has a modern, clean architectural style.
